question:
I'm trying to convert timestamp (long value) into date only (YYYY-MM-DD) with the below query.

SELECT
    id,
    scheme_name,
    DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME({{'scheme_t'}})) AS scheme_date
FROM
    scheme_table;

scheme_table definition:- CREATE TABLE scheme_table( id varchar(225), scheme_name varchar(225), scheme_t long );

input:- 1672492800 (timestamp) output:- 1970-01-01
title: Conversion of timestamp(long value) to date only(YYYY-MM-DD) in DBT
answer:
I think you can use this query directly to get the desired results:

select *, timestamp 'epoch' + unixdate::INT * INTERVAL '1 second' as test from {{ source("yourmodel","table_name")}}
